contexts.text: The principles which a man has taken in from infancy, if... not contrary to Divine and natural order, but in themselves matters of indifference, the Lord leaves, and suffers him to remain in them.
Is it not at this day a matter of indifference what truths a man knows...
The accessory joys (then) become matters of indifference, and finally sad...
They make for themselves scruples... even in... matters of indifference.
He thinks (about the Holy Supper) What is this but a matter of indifference?
The rest... are either ceremonials, which are matters of indifference...
5. Building orphanages, etc., which are partly matters of indifference...
